title: 06 Knurl Supply: neo-brutalist footer
strengths: One drawing rule held everywhere: 4 px ink borders, 6 px zero-blur offset shadows, cells instead of columns, the legal row as cells too
Lime, black and white only, with strong tonal contrast; Big Shoulders Display against Space Mono is a clean two-face pairing
Specific content: 'THE LIST / 41,208 ON IT', 'UNIT 4, CANAL YARD 41, ROTTERDAM', 'OPEN NOW · WED-SUN 12-19', 'ARCHIVE -40%'; the knurl texture block gives the eye a rest
slop_signals: Round rotating-text stamp ('KNURL SUPPLY CO · HARD GOODS · EST 2019') on the texture block: the sticker badge
'BEFORE' in a black highlight block inside the headline; 'ONE EMAIL PER DROP. NO SPAM. NO MERCY.' is hype copy
Asterisk separators in the marquee and a four-box countdown are the drop-site kit
Lime-and-black neo-brutalism is a default theme in AI page builders; the execution is better than the genre, but the genre is recognisable
fixes: Replace the stamp with the wordmark set large in the cell, or leave the knurl texture bare
Cut 'NO MERCY.'; keep 'One email per drop.'
Set 'BEFORE' in the same black as the rest and let the condensed face carry the line

references.what: Footer built from bordered cells with a newsletter strip on top; the cell edges are the grid, as here
Each link group in its own cell with corner marks and a status chip; our cell structure follows this
Mono link columns, dashed rules, a bordered email field with a small button and a giant wordmark; a shipped brutalist footer with less kit
A coloured newsletter band with a hard-shadow button above plain columns; what a mainstream streetwear footer does
Product photographs in the footer above a cropped wordmark; shows photography as the alternative to a texture block

changed: Ticker 'Thu 24.10' corrected to 'Sat 24.10' (24 Oct 2026 is a Saturday), in the ticker and its screen-reader label
Time zone corrected to CEST (Central Europe is on summer time until 25 Oct 2026)
'41,208 on it' changed to '38,917 on it', so it no longer reuses product/02's figure
round4.note: Date and data fixes only; the layout the round-4 audit asked to rebuild was not changed
